kjv: lead away captive, bring into captivity

occurrences.text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
